thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — Elevated 5xx rate detected in gateway (us-west-2). Metric: gateway.5xx_rate increased from 0.7% -> 12% over 3m. Incident ID INC-20260317-12. Telemetry dashboard: https://ops.redwood/queries/INC-20260317-12

sara: oncall sara here, ack. joining. pulling traces and recent deploys.

jamie: seeing spike too, ~12–15% 503s at peak, latency for affected reqs ~1200ms. upstream service "model-serve-pool-2" shows increased retry rate.

nate: initial grep of logs shows a pattern of upstream timeouts + connection resets. sample corrids: 0f4a1c2d, 3b9e7f22, a71c9b00.

nate: log snippet:
```
[ingress] level=error ts=2026-03-17T14:12:34Z corrid=0f4a1c2d status=503 upstream="model-serve-pool-2" message="upstream timeout after 1000ms" request_id=req-8732
[egress] level=warn ts=2026-03-17T14:12:35Z corrid=0f4a1c2d retry=1 err="connection reset by peer"
```

cheng: can someone collect the logbundle for those corrids? I'll need kvcache traces + egress metrics.

sara: running collect now: `/runbook collect-logs --corrid 0f4a1c2d,3b9e7f22,a71c9b00 --include=kvcache,egress-traces`

cheng: uploaded log bundle to s3: s3://incidents/3765439999/logs_3765439999.zip — permissions: read for eng-sre, oncall.

molly: early hypothesis: upstream autoscaler lag under burst + client retries causing amplification. Also seeing some 429 -> client retry loops in the egress logs.

jamie: to mitigate: proposing route-based fallback to smaller/quantized model variant for a % of routing to reduce pressure on that pool. Canary 20% for 10m then evaluate.

sara: agreed. applying traffic-split via runtime console now. route change: `traffic_split: model-serve-v2=80, model-serve-v2-quant=20` — rolling update started.

deploy-bot: ROUTE CHANGE applied by sara (oncall). config_id=cfg-8812, rollout=canary(20%).

incident-bot: CUSTOMER IMPACT: ~120 reqs/min failing at peak. Top impacted customers: alpha-co, beta-inc (support tickets: #3254, #3256). Some streaming sessions saw partial truncation.

support-bot: Support notified for alpha-co and beta-inc, created priority tickets and linked to log bundle.

nate: monitoring after route change: gateway 5xx dropped to ~3% within 4m. latency P95 improved from 1200ms -> 420ms for canary users.

molly: leaving this as open hypothesis list: 1) autoscaler reaction lag (cold nodes + slow startup), 2) retry amplification (client/backoff misconfig), 3) transient network egress resets to pool-2.

cheng: attn: no deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot. So less likely to be recent code change.

deploy-bot: recent deploys: none to model-serve-pool-2 in last 60m.

jamie: next steps: collect detailed heap/CPU metrics from pool-2, check node spin-up logs, gather nginx/socket-level errors. adding timeline entries to the incident doc.

sara: documented mitigation steps + timeline in incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/INC-20260317-12/timeline — moving paging to monitoring-only in 15m if metrics remain stable.

nate: aggregating traces and will run failure-mode replays on a staging replica to validate retry/backoff behavior.

molly: note for RCA: extract a sample of 200 failed traces and correlate with autoscaler events + pod creation timestamps. Include K8s events.

jamie: still seeing occasional 503s for older corrids but stable trend downward. will keep canary at 20% for 15m and then shift to 5%.

sara: prepping postmortem ticket and assigning to eng-sre + runtime for deeper root cause. Ticket: PM-INC-20260317-12.

cheng: handoff: moving detailed analysis to #eng-sre. logging final observation: fallback routing reduced 5xx by ~75% and reduced customer impact.

sara: thanks all — paging cleared, handing off to RCA owners. I'll add hypotheses list and attach the log bundle to the postmortem. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident status update: mitigation in place, monitoring. Next update in 30m or earlier if regression."
